WITH district_counts AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.A3 AS region,
        COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count
    FROM district AS d
    LEFT JOIN account AS a
        ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3
), above_region_average AS (
    SELECT
        district_id,
        region,
        account_count,
        account_count - AVG(account_count) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS above_region_average
    FROM district_counts
    WHERE account_count > AVG(account_count) OVER (PARTITION BY region)
)
SELECT
    district_id,
    region,
    account_count,
    above_region_average,
    account_count / AVG(account_count) OVER () AS ratio_to_average_above_average_count
FROM above_region_average
ORDER BY ratio_to_average_above_average_count DESC
LIMIT 10;
